summary: fractal-ui gains SystemNotice (one quiet system-state row) and ConnectionStatus (one connection band). The web app shows the gateway connection once, under the thread header, and renders the roster, Missions and pane loading/unavailable states with SystemNotice.

compatibility.detail: New kit exports SystemNotice, ConnectionStatus, SystemStateKind and ConnectionState from @smalltalk/fractal-ui/assistant-ui and /shell. The sidebar footer no longer shows connection text or 'Reconnect now'; the band (data-connection-state) renders nothing while live or first connecting. Notice copy changed (e.g. 'Loading agents', 'Last observed roster', 'View not available here') and rows carry data-system-state; data-wf-roster-reason is kept. workspaceViewNotice is removed.
